authority.process: AI-Assisted Software Engineering Governance Standard v1.0
sources: G4-07 SRC-19 authorization/bounds: COL-GPU D0; 16MiB, 2048 entries, 4s, DRM and PCI identity read-only; no workload or writes
G4-02/06 SRC-19 Source Evidence Map: per deterministic enumeration/read entry; original path retained
G5-03 accepted passive_worker.py ROOTS/ATTRS and successful source_paths receipt mapping; G5-04 CP-01 D01..05

path_contract.recording: Only successfully sealed original paths in worker acquisition order; item0001 corresponds to source_paths[0], etc. Missing optional attributes preserved separately in unavailable_fields.
path_contract.identity: private gpu.drm.<cardN>.pci.<field> derived from original recorded path, never from bytes
prohibitions: No raw-source pointers in public outputs

interpretation: Bounded UTF-8 single-line PCI numeric ID raw string starting 0x, 2-8 hex digits; normalize lower-case as identifier STRING only. No invented GPU vendor/model or supported codec, no physical capability assertion.
ambiguity: Vendor/PCI attribute values malformed or absent are not fabricated; preserve raw bytes and record real parser error if parse attempted.

cases.expected: 2 valid card0 PCI attributes including mixed-case hex produce exact private datum_paths, string identity, 1:1 sealed evidence; manifest validates
card10 before card2 in lexical worker order; value-only identity never remaps card paths
optional absent attribute yields unavailable_fields only; no semantic observation for missing field
source_paths length mismatch with sealed items rejects before manifest
swapped fixed attribute order, duplicate path, non-lexical cards, tampered itemNNNN ordinal reject
traversal, wrong root, cardX, renderD128, device/driver, unsupported PCI attribute reject without host I/O
cross-run sealed identity and changed bytes reject original integrity
invalid UTF-8, nonhex IDs, multiple lines, excessive bytes are actual parser failures, original evidence remains unmodified
unknown but syntactically valid PCI ID normalized as identifier only, not vendor name or benchmark capability

independence: Source-first test expectations drafted before parser implementation; same AI author, not independent human review. CI pass is scoped, not 283-requirement or gate acceptance.
